qualification_source_alignment.scope: Native, generated and engine inputs were frozen for host qualification while Java UI work continued. Every frozen native input matches the later complete APK freeze. Host diagnostic flags are excluded from Android; this does not test a physical phone or its GPU.

build_attempts.cause: Sandbox blocked the local IPC socket required by the Gradle daemon before project compilation. The authorized retry ran offline with local IPC permitted.
DEX compilation observed temporary duplicate class files within the Java compiler output. Java and project DEX intermediates were regenerated; production sources were unchanged.
